tools.name: read_note
tools.description: Read a note from the Obsidian vault

path.description: Path to the note relative to vault root

prettyPrint.description: Format JSON response with indentation (default: false)

tools.name: write_note
tools.description: Write a note to the Obsidian vault

path.description: Path to the note relative to vault root

tools.name: patch_note
tools.description: Efficiently update part of a note by replacing a specific string. This is more efficient than rewriting the entire note for small changes.

path.description: Path to the note relative to vault root

oldString.description: The exact string to replace. Must match exactly including whitespace and line breaks.

newString.description: The new string to insert in place of oldString

replaceAll.description: If true, replace all occurrences. If false (default), the operation will fail if multiple matches are found to prevent unintended replacements.

tools.name: list_directory
tools.description: List files and directories in the vault (includes non-note filenames, while read/write tools remain note-only)

prettyPrint.description: Format JSON response with indentation (default: false)

tools.name: delete_note
tools.description: Delete a note from the Obsidian vault (requires confirmation)

path.description: Path to the note relative to vault root

confirmPath.description: Confirmation: must exactly match the path parameter to proceed with deletion

tools.name: search_notes
tools.description: Search for notes in the vault by content or frontmatter

prettyPrint.description: Format JSON response with indentation (default: false)

tools.name: move_note
tools.description: Move or rename a note in the vault

tools.name: move_file
tools.description: Move or rename any file in the vault (binary-safe, file-only, requires confirmation)

tools.name: read_multiple_notes
tools.description: Read multiple notes in a batch (max 10 files)

paths.description: Array of note paths to read

prettyPrint.description: Format JSON response with indentation (default: false)

tools.name: update_frontmatter
tools.description: Update frontmatter of a note without changing content

tools.name: get_notes_info
tools.description: Get metadata for notes without reading full content

paths.description: Array of note paths to get info for

prettyPrint.description: Format JSON response with indentation (default: false)

tools.name: get_frontmatter
tools.description: Extract frontmatter from a note without reading the content

path.description: Path to the note relative to vault root

prettyPrint.description: Format JSON response with indentation (default: false)

tools.name: manage_tags
tools.description: Add, remove, or list tags in a note

path.description: Path to the note relative to vault root

tags.description: Array of tags (required for 'add' and 'remove' operations)

tools.name: get_vault_stats
tools.description: Get vault statistics including total notes, folders, size, and recently modified files. Useful for understanding vault scope before batch operations.

recentCount.description: Number of recently modified files to return (default: 5, max: 20)

prettyPrint.description: Format JSON response with indentation (default: false)

tools.name: list_all_tags
tools.description: List all tags across the vault with occurrence counts. Returns both frontmatter tags and inline #hashtags, deduplicated and sorted by frequency. Useful for discovering existing tags before creating or organizing notes.

prettyPrint.description: Format JSON response with indentation (default: false)
